pages.title: Armor and Healing
pages.text: Combining armor and healing, this necklace keeps both effects in one accessory slot.

pages.title: Crafting the Necklace
pages.text: Combine a Warding Emblem and Natural Dragon Heart Necklace anywhere in the grid.

pages.title: Growth and Recovery
pages.text: The armor bonus grows with the dragon's stage. It restores health in either form, more slowly while severely injured.
